advancement.meadow.buffalo.desc: Prove your strength by taking down a Water Buffalo.
advancement.meadow.cheese_collector.desc: Collect every type of cheese Meadow has to offer.
advancement.meadow.cheese_form.desc: Craft and place a Cheese Form
advancement.meadow.find_meadow.desc: Embark on an adventure to uncover the hidden beauty of the Meadow biome.
advancement.meadow.fondue.desc: Dip bread into a pot of melted cheese and savor the flavor
advancement.meadow.frame.desc: Craft and place a Cooking Frame to elevate your culinary creations.
advancement.meadow.fur_armor.desc: Craft and wear fur armor to stay warm and look fabulous in the wilds.
advancement.meadow.get_cheese.desc: Craft your very first cheese and begin your dairy-making legacy.
advancement.meadow.milk_bucket_collector: Collect every unique type of milk, whether from animals or other sources.
advancement.meadow.salt.desc: Alpine Salt can be found in Meadow Biomes.
advancement.meadow.spyglass_at_buffalo.d: Look at a Water Buffalo through a Spyglass
advancement.meadow.straw_bed.desc: Endure a night on a straw bed and wake up with an achy back.
advancement.meadow.woodcutter.desc: Place a Woodcutter, use an axe on it, insert logs or wood, and let the Woodcutter do the hard work for you!
advancement.meadow.wool_collector.desc: Gather all 7 unique types of wool introduced by Meadow.
tooltip.meadow.banner.thankyou_1: A reward for crafting all Cheese Variants
tooltip.meadow.banner.thankyou_4: Grants Dig Speed II within 8 blocks
tooltip.meadow.milk_can.info_0: Cows nearby fill it with milk over time. Take the milk out with a Bucket.
tooltip.meadow.climbing_rope.info_0: Place it under a block and it unrolls downwards, so you can climb it.
tooltip.meadow.watering_can.info_0: Waters nearby crops and soil. Use it on water to refill.
tooltip.meadow.felting_needle.info_0: Hold Wool in your off hand and keep using the needle to felt it into Meadow Wool.
